title: How wmti Works
description: A quick tour of how wmti walks you through codebases

steps.title: JSON Walkthrough Files
steps.description: wmti creates and reads these JSON files to walk through your project. Each file describes a walkthrough with a title, description, and a series of steps.

steps.title: Each Step Defines a View
steps.description: Each 'step' in the steps array tells wmti which file to display, which lines to show, and what description to display in the sidebar.

steps.title: Cyclic Navigation
steps.description: When you reach the last step, pressing Tab will loop back to the first step. Similarly, Shift+Tab cycles backwards.

steps.title: Creating Walkthroughs
steps.description: You can create new walkthroughs by simply adding a JSON file to the .wmti/ folder. Each file must follow the *.wmti.json naming convention.
